key_insight: Adapting measurement latency to the remaining error budget and QEC rounds can shorten logical cycles while reducing logical errors.
engineering_relevance: DynaMite targets measurement bottlenecks that account for 43–86% of logical cycle time in fault-tolerant quantum computing.
method: Optimize measurement latency for logical performance rather than per-qubit readout fidelity alone.
Track the remaining error budget and QEC rounds during each logical cycle.
Select the fastest measurement latency for the upcoming round based on that runtime state.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports logical cycle speedups averaging 1.69× and reaching 2.29×, with logical error rates averaging 0.46× baseline and reaching as low as 0.13×.
watch_item: Practical deployment requires timely error-budget feedback and hardware support for changing measurement latency; the abstract does not quantify these implementation overheads.
paper_title: DynaMite: Dynamic Measurement Scheduling To Accelerate Fault-Tolerant Quantum Programs
